order_wins: **Bondada Engineering** — receives a **Rs 1,153.93 crore (incl. taxes) EPC order** for a 270 MWp ground-mounted solar project in Maharashtra, due in 6 months, from an unnamed developer in which its promoter group has an interest _(related-party order; ~38.3% of mcap)_.

**Transrail Lighting** — secures **new T&D orders worth Rs 412 crore**, mainly HTLS transmission-line reconductoring, taking FY order intake to Rs 2,021 crore; a further Rs 409 crore of L1 positions are not yet awarded _(~6.6% of mcap)_.

**Capacit'e Infraprojects** — receives a **Rs 368.98 crore (excl. GST) Letter of Acceptance from Chennai Metro Rail** for buildings near Thirumangalam Metro Station, covering civil, finishes, MEP and lifts _(~24.4% of mcap)_.

**Solex Energy** — subsidiary Solex Green Energy wins a **Rs 180.98 crore (incl. taxes) order for TOPCon bifacial glass-to-glass solar modules** from an undisclosed domestic power-sector entity, due by January 2027 _(~24.6% of mcap)_.

**Om Power Transmission** — receives a **Letter of Intent from Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation for Rs 69.18 crore (incl. GST)** to build the 220 kV D/C Prantij-Jantral line (Package 2) on a turnkey basis, over 24 months _(~12.2% of mcap)_.

**Om Power Transmission** — receives a second GETCO Letter of Intent the same evening, **Rs 60.48 crore (incl. GST)** for the turnkey 220 kV Kotda-Sanghani AIS substation, over 18 months _(~10.7% of mcap)_.

**Shakti Pumps** — receives a **Letter of Empanelment from MSEDCL for 4,755 off-grid solar water pumps worth ~Rs 112.18 crore incl. GST** (Rs 103.01 cr ex-GST); the 60-day execution clock starts only when the work order is issued _(~2.0% of mcap)_.

**Interarch Building Solutions** — wins a **~Rs 61 crore (incl. taxes) pre-engineered steel building order for a copper refinery in Gujarat** from an undisclosed domestic customer, over ~12 months with a 20% advance _(~2.2% of mcap)_.

**Axis Solutions** — wins a **EUR 4.03 million (~Rs 43.51 crore, per the filing) lump-sum order from John Cockerill Hydrogen Belgium** for 128 gas analysers at a Kakinada project, delivering July-December 2027 _(~1.4% of mcap)_.
**Ameenji Rubber** — receives a **Rs 13.41 crore purchase order from South Central Railway** for the manufacture and supply of rubber pads, to be executed in 12 months _(~4.2% of mcap)_.

**Annu Projects** — receives a **Rs 12.81 crore Letter of Acceptance from Northeast Frontier Railway** for a 4x48-fibre optical backbone over 143 route-km in Tinsukia division under KAVACH, over 24 months _(~4.3% of mcap)_.

**Kay Cee Energy & Infra** — wins a **Rs 12.09 crore (incl. GST) Letter of Award from Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Prasaran Nigam** to maintain 220 kV substations and lines in the Jaisalmer, Ramgarh and Bhadla circles _(~12.7% of mcap)_.
**Mphasis** — signs an **agreement worth approximately £35.4 million with Social Security Scotland** to manage and maintain its core benefits platform, which serves about 2 million citizens.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Shiva Granito Export** — board approves a preferential issue of Rs 5.72 crore of equity to 17 non-promoter investors and Rs 3.675 crore of warrants, both at Rs 10.50 (**Rs 9.40 crore together**, our sum; ~64.5% of mcap), subject to an EGM on 5 November.

**Craftroot Retail** — board approves up to 2 crore convertible warrants at Rs 11 to promoter and public allottees (**Rs 22 crore**, our arithmetic), subject to shareholder approval at an EGM on 5 November.

**Ola Electric Mobility** — receives the exchanges' in-principle approval for a rights issue of partly paid-up shares of **up to Rs 1,000 crore** _(~5.9% of mcap)_; its board meets on 7 October to set price, ratio and record date.

**PTC Industries** — opens its qualified institutions placement on 6 October at a **floor price of Rs 22,150 per share**, with a discount of up to 5% permitted; the issue price will be set with the book-running lead managers.

**Tega Industries** — receives NSE and BSE in-principle approval to issue 4,78,435 shares at Rs 1,994 each to a non-promoter investor on a preferential basis (**Rs 95.40 crore**, our arithmetic; ~0.6% of mcap).
equity_allotments: **Shukra Pharmaceuticals** — allots 17,35,000 shares to promoters Anar Jayesh Patel and Anar Projects on converting warrants issued earlier, on receipt of the Rs 26.67-per-warrant balance (**Rs 4.63 crore**, our arithmetic).
m_and_a: **KNR Constructions** — completes the sale of its **entire stake in KNR Ramanattukara Infra to Indus Infra Trust, receiving Rs 549.14 crore** against Rs 225.72 crore invested; the SPV ceased to be a subsidiary on 5 October _(~17.4% of mcap)_.

**Endurance Technologies** — Italian subsidiary Endurance Overseas buys 100% of **Fondalpress, an aluminium die-casting and machining maker for automobiles, for EUR 12.34 million**, via its parent Anna Milena and the minority holders.

**Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences** — board approves buying up to 51% of **Sarvottam Health Care (Trust Hospitals, Kakinada), a hospital it already operates, for up to Rs 80 crore** _(~0.3% of mcap)_, by 31 October.

**Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences** — also approves up to **Rs 40 crore of primary equity in Splendid Hospitals (Kompally)**, up to 51% of Insignia Healthcare (Guntur) at Rs 30.35 a share, and 6% of a Sangli hospital LLP, all hospitals it operates.

**Gabriel India** — signs a passenger-vehicle seating JV with Forvia's Faurecia Automotive Seating India, holding 50% less one share for Rs 9.99 crore at incorporation plus Rs 40 crore at closing; the JV takes over Faurecia's seat-frames business.

**Meesho** — board approves investing **up to Rs 50 crore** in Retail Pulse Labs (Kirana Club) within a year of the first tranche of its Rs 202.09 crore Kirana Club acquisition, disclosed on 12 June, whose terms are unchanged.

**Adani Power** — signs a shareholders' agreement with Bhutan's state utility Druk Green Power to build the **770 MW Chamkharchhu hydropower project** through a 49:51 joint venture, initially taking 4.9 million shares at BTN 100 each.

**Marsons** — board approves a **joint venture with Cleanhill Partners**, a US company to import, sell and service its transformers in the US and Canada and later make them there, subject to a JV agreement (value not disclosed).
**RDB Infrastructure and Power** — signs an MoU to buy Samvik Power's shares in Maxim Industries, lifting its stake in Maxim from 29% to 45%.

**Kabra Extrusiontechnik** — incorporates Geon International FZ-LLC in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, with **AED 3.9 million** of share capital, as the intermediary holding company for its international business.

**Privi Speciality Chemicals** — NCLT Mumbai convenes a **shareholders' meeting on 27 October** to vote on merging group companies Privi Fine Sciences and Privi Biotechnologies into the company; creditor meetings were dispensed with.

**Shristi Infrastructure Development** — board approves demerging its Krishnagar Sentrum mixed-use real-estate project into wholly owned Shristi Realty Holdings, with shares to its holders; the unit was 18.37% of FY26 standalone turnover.
**Visagar Polytex** — files a composite scheme of arrangement with its shareholders providing for a reduction of share capital and a preferential issue of equity shares and warrants.
**BirlaNu** — NCLT Hyderabad sanctions the amalgamation of Clean Coats into the company; the transferor's petition before the Mumbai bench is still pending.
**Repro India** — subsidiary Repro Books completes the acquisition of 100% of Sharjah-based Repro LLC, agreed in August, which becomes a step-down wholly owned subsidiary.
capex_core: **JSW Cement** — commissions an **additional 1 MTPA grinding unit at Nagaur, Rajasthan**, taking that plant to 3.5 MTPA and its total grinding capacity to 25.1 MTPA.

**Godrej Consumer Products** — its Indonesian subsidiary inaugurates phase one of a household-insecticides plant in the Kendal SEZ, part of an **IDR 500 billion (approx. Rs 250 crore, per the filing) investment**.
**Godawari Power & Ispat** — subsidiary Godawari New Energy receives **environment clearance to build the facility for its 20 GWh battery energy storage system project** at AURIC Bidkin, Maharashtra.
business_updates: **Results season** — 11 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Titan Company** — Q2 FY27 consumer businesses grow about 25% YoY, with jewellery up 21%, CaratLane 32%, watches 30% and eyecare 28%; 78 net store additions take the network to 3,758.
**Max Estates** — reports **H1 FY27 pre-sales of ~Rs 3,200 crore**, including ~Rs 2,100 crore in Q2 against Rs 156 crore a year earlier, with Q2 collections of ~Rs 560 crore.

**Honasa Consumer** — expects Q2 FY27 net sales value growth in the early thirties YoY, with Mamaearth in the high teens and younger brands around the mid-forties, and an early double-digit operating margin.
**Utkarsh Small Finance Bank** — Q2 FY27 disbursements rise 54.9% YoY to Rs 3,525 crore, gross loan portfolio 7.5% to Rs 20,063 crore and deposits 6.6% to Rs 23,869 crore (provisional).
**Indian Energy Exchange** — Q2 FY27 electricity traded volume rises **12.7% YoY to 39,685 MU**, with September up 10.4% to 12,220 MU.
**Angel One** — September client base grows **17.3% YoY to 39.98 million** and the average client funding book **41.7% to Rs 78.71 billion**, while gross client acquisition falls 17.1%.
**Shyam Metalics and Energy** — September stainless-steel sales volume rises **35.06% YoY to 9,778 MT**, at an average realisation of Rs 1,68,803 per tonne.
**Meesho** — says **Content Commerce net merchandise value grew 152% YoY** over the 12 months to August, driven by 1.6 lakh active creators, about 90% of them nano creators.
**Glen Industries** — H1 FY27 revenue of **Rs 113.57 crore, up 18.84% YoY**, with exports at 26% of revenue.
**Mahindra Lifespace Developers** — launches Mahindra Rivenza, a 13.46-acre project in Baner Annex, Pune with an estimated GDV of ~Rs 3,500 crore; phase 1 offers 1,236 homes.
**United Breweries** — receives **income-tax refunds of Rs 100.83 crore**: Rs 82.73 crore for AY 2013-14 and Rs 18.10 crore for AY 2020-21, as determined in orders giving effect to earlier rulings.
**H.G. Infra Engineering** — Karnataka's Deputy Commissioner of Commercial Taxes **drops a Rs 94 crore demand in full**, closing the show-cause proceedings at nil tax, interest and penalty.

**MBL Infrastructure** — Dehradun's Commercial Court orders Uttarakhand's Public Works Department to **deposit Rs 81.14 crore under a December 2024 arbitration award**, with 12% annual interest running until payment.
**Tata Chemicals** — the Supreme Court **bars the Gujarat government from coercive action** over its legacy wastewater channels at Mithapur and seeks the state's response.
**Regaal Resources** — restores operations at its 825 TPD Kishanganj, Bihar plant after repairing a damaged 10 MW turbine; the repair cost Rs 90 lakh plus freight, with an insurance claim in process.
distress_risk: **Dhanuka Agritech** — receives seven Haryana entry-tax demand orders for FY2008-09 to FY2014-15 totalling **Rs 55.53 crore** (our sum) _(~1.4% of mcap)_; it calls them not maintainable and is weighing a writ.

**Refex Renewables & Infrastructure** — Warana Sugar blocks access and utilities to step-down subsidiary Refex CBG Kolhapur's biogas plant over alleged dues of **Rs 18.48 crore**, which Refex says were settled; operations are severely impacted.

**HCL Infosystems** — a Muzaffarpur court allows Uttar Bihar Gramin Bank's challenge to a 2019 arbitral award of **Rs 13.41 crore plus 18% interest** to subsidiary HCL Infotech, which calls the judgment ambiguous.
**Reliance Communications** — the DoT terminates with immediate effect the spectrum RCOM and subsidiary Reliance Telecom won in the 2010-2016 auctions and orders them to stop using it.
**Spright Agro** — NCLT Ahmedabad admits a Section 9 petition and starts insolvency proceedings against the company; an interim resolution professional takes over from the suspended board.

**Gokak Textiles** — closes its knitwear garment division at Marihal, Belagavi from 6 October, after state permission was deemed granted under the Industrial Disputes Act; all its workers' services stand terminated.
**IL&FS Engineering and Construction** — after Committee of Creditors approval of the resolution proposal, the IL&FS board **clears filing it with NCLT Mumbai** for approval.

**ARSS Infrastructure Projects** — Roger Bravo AIF steps back as nominee holder of the 7.35 crore plan shares (~81.55%) allotted under its approved resolution plan; the applicant Ocean Capital Market or its nominee is to be substituted.
**Baron Infotech** — withdraws its 6 October record date after NCLAT Chennai ordered status quo on an unsuccessful resolution applicant's appeal.
**The Hi-Tech Gears** — NCLAT continues its interim stay on the company's insolvency process and lists the matter for 7 October.
open_offers: **Hiliks Technologies Ltd** — FROM THE PUBLIC SHAREHOLDERS OF HILIKS BY ENACT TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED open offer for 26.0% (36.92 lakh shares) at Rs 72 vs CMP 65.06 (+10.7%); change of control (Reg 4) + >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); **TENDER - offer above market**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 70 cr
credit_rating_changes: **PNB Housing Finance** — CRISIL **upgrades its long-term bank facilities and debt to AAA/Stable from AA+/Stable**, now factoring in support from promoter Punjab National Bank; the short-term A1+ is reaffirmed.
**Juniper Green Energy** — ICRA upgrades subsidiary Nisagra Renewable Energy's term loans to **AA- (Stable) from A+**, and India Ratings lifts Juniper Green Cosmic to **A- (Stable) from BBB+**.
**HP Telecom India** — CARE **upgrades its long-term bank-facility rating two notches to BBB+/Stable from BBB-/Positive** and its short-term rating to A2 from A3.
**Kings Infra Ventures** — Infomerics **downgrades its long-term bank facilities and NCDs to IVR B/Negative** under 'Issuer Not Cooperating', after the company failed to submit no-default statements.
other_notable: **Atal Realtech** — withdraws its proposed **Rs 16 crore rights issue**, approved on 17 August, citing unfavourable market conditions; no letter of offer had been issued and no money received.
